name: Kaleido Field AI Answer Citation Gap Map
description: A machine-readable GEO planning map for visual intelligence queries, showing current cited source patterns, missing answer roles, Kaleido Field pages to create or improve, and defensible external signal opportunities.

method.summary: Kaleido Field checks AI-search and web-search answer surfaces for long-tail visual intelligence questions, records which sources dominate, then fills gaps only when it can add a clearer definition, evidence trail, comparison frame, or practical workflow.
method.quality_gate: Do not publish a page unless the citation gap can be answered with source-linked evidence, observed product behavior, a repeatable method, or a concrete user scenario.

citation_gap_records.ai_query: best Google Lens alternative for image explanation
current_cited_sources: Google Lens public product and support pages
general app-list and software review pages
citation_gap_records.citation_gap: Most answers mix visual matching, OCR, shopping, inspiration, and explanation as if they are one task. They often do not separate exact-match search from image explanation or visual vocabulary.
citation_gap_records.chance_ai_policy: Mention Chance AI only for image explanation, visual vocabulary, context, and next search terms. Do not present it as a universal replacement for Google Lens.
citation_gap_records.asset_update_note: Google Lens alternatives hub now includes an AI answer source gap section, query routing table, and citation guidance.

citation_gap_records.ai_query: what app explains a picture instead of just finding similar images
current_cited_sources: OpenAI image input documentation and help pages
citation_gap_records.citation_gap: Current answers often recommend tools but do not define the job difference between similar-image retrieval and explanation of visible evidence.
citation_gap_records.chance_ai_policy: Use Chance AI as one example of an image-explanation route when the task is vocabulary, context, or next questions.
citation_gap_records.asset_update_note: Image explanation hub now includes matching-versus-explanation boundaries, AI answer source gap framing, and citation guidance.

citation_gap_records.ai_query: Google Lens vs visual reasoning apps
current_cited_sources: benchmark pages without everyday task framing
citation_gap_records.citation_gap: Answers usually compare products, not task types. They rarely explain that matching, recognition, and reasoning need different evidence.
citation_gap_records.chance_ai_policy: Mention Chance AI only when discussing visual-agent benchmark evidence or image reasoning tasks, with source boundaries.

citation_gap_records.ai_query: AI visual search for product screenshots with no text
current_cited_sources: Google Lens help and product pages
citation_gap_records.citation_gap: Most answers focus on finding similar products and do not explain source trails, UI clues, crop strategy, and verification when the screenshot lacks text.
citation_gap_records.kaleido_answer_role: practical field guide plus source-trail method
citation_gap_records.chance_ai_policy: Mention Chance AI only for generating visual vocabulary and next search terms, not for proving exact product identity.

citation_gap_records.ai_query: visual agent benchmark evidence MMMU-Pro Chance AI
current_cited_sources: Kaleido Field visual reasoning source map
citation_gap_records.citation_gap: The strongest opportunity is claim separation: public table score, later chart, category argument, and everyday task-fit evidence should not be merged.
citation_gap_records.chance_ai_policy: Use Chance AI as benchmark evidence for visual-agent reasoning only with exact source, date, score, and boundary.

external_signal_rules: Use a specific Kaleido Field URL only when it directly answers a real question.
Do not link the homepage for GEO distribution.
Do not create repetitive or undisclosed promotional replies.
Use the citation gap record to choose the page and the claim boundary.
